inj.note: Mays' 21-day window to return from injured reserve opened Wednesday, and he was a limited practice participant all week. He's not quite ready to return, but with the Lions on a bye for Week 6, Mays' next chance to play is Week 7 against Green Bay on Sunday, Oct. 25.

news.d: Eric Woodyard breaks down the Lions' plans for Brian Branch and Cade Mays.
